The Windows 10 display settings allow you to change the appearance of your desktop and customize it to your liking. There are many different display settings you can adjust, from adjusting the brightness of your screen to choosing the size of text and icons on your monitor. Here is a step-by-step guide on how to adjust your Windows 10 display settings.

1. Find the Start button located at the bottom left corner of your screen. Click on the Start button and then select Settings.

2. In the Settings window, click on System.

3. On the left side of the window, click on Display. This will open up the display settings options.

4. You can adjust the brightness of your screen by using the slider located at the top of the page. You can also change the scaling of your screen by selecting one of the preset sizes or manually adjusting the slider.

5. To adjust the size of text and icons on your monitor, scroll down to the Scale and layout section. Here you can choose between the recommended size and manually entering a custom size. Once you have chosen the size you would like, click the Apply button to save your changes.

6. You can also adjust the orientation of your display by clicking the dropdown menu located under Orientation. You have the options to choose between landscape, portrait, and rotated.

7. Next, scroll down to the Multiple displays section. Here you can choose to extend your display or duplicate it onto another monitor.

8. Finally, scroll down to the Advanced display settings section. Here you can find more advanced display settings such as resolution and color depth.

By making these adjustments to your Windows 10 display settings, you can customize your desktop to fit your personal preference. Additionally, these settings can help improve the clarity of your monitor for a better viewing experience.

The Windows 10 display settings allow you to change the appearance of your desktop and customize it to your liking. There are many different display settings you can adjust, from adjusting the brightness of your screen to choosing the size of text and icons on your monitor. Here is a step-by-step guide on how to adjust your Windows 10 display settings.

1. Find the Start button located at the bottom left corner of your screen. Click on the Start button and then select Settings.

2. In the Settings window, click on System.

3. On the left side of the window, click on Display. This will open up the display settings options.

4. You can adjust the brightness of your screen by using the slider located at the top of the page. You can also change the scaling of your screen by selecting one of the preset sizes or manually adjusting the slider.

5. To adjust the size of text and icons on your monitor, scroll down to the Scale and layout section. Here you can choose between the recommended size and manually entering a custom size. Once you have chosen the size you would like, click the Apply button to save your changes.

6. You can also adjust the orientation of your display by clicking the dropdown menu located under Orientation. You have the options to choose between landscape, portrait, and rotated.

7. Next, scroll down to the Multiple displays section. Here you can choose to extend your display or duplicate it onto another monitor.

8. Finally, scroll down to the Advanced display settings section. Here you can find more advanced display settings such as resolution and color depth.

By making these adjustments to your Windows 10 display settings, you can customize your desktop to fit your personal preference. Additionally, these settings can help improve the clarity of your monitor for a better viewing experience.

entry.title: Top 2021 Moments with PCDJ – A Yearly Recap for Fans
entry.content:
Top 2021 Moments with PCDJ – A Yearly Recap for Fans

2021 is in the books – upward and onward to twenty double deuce!

Learn More about DEX 3 (Our Best Product)

2022 marks PCDJ’s 23rd year creating professional live performance software solutions for pro DJs and karaoke hosts. The journey from “no one will ever DJ with a computer” to helping propel the digital DJ software industry to the forefront of the DJ space has been quite the ride. We have you, our loyal customers, to thank. We appreciate all the support you’ve given us over the last two plus decades.🙏🏽

Over the course of the past year the pandemic continued to prevent many DJs and Karaoke Hosts from doing what they love. However, many were able to return to some level of normalcy performing live events. This was evident in the increase in business PCDJ received from professionals and venues. We’re confident we’ll see this trend continue in 2022 as the global community continues to recover and fight coronavirus. The people of the world can certainly use us right now, spreading positive vibes through unique musical performances.

Throughout 2021 our team continued to strive for perfection in the bat cave, improving existing software functionality and developing new features and support for third-party services along the way. We saw our latest karaoke show hosting solution, LYRX (Mac/Windows) , rapidly become our most popular karaoke show hosting solution in our lineup and DEX 3 reaching new levels of industry notoriety. It will be more of the same in 2022, with new and unique software features and partnerships in the works that will strongly benefit your musical performances.

As we like to do at the expiry of each year, here’s a look at a few PCDJ milestones in 2021.

Disclaimer: This post includes affiliate links

If you click on a link and make a purchase, I may receive a commission at no extra cost to you.

2021 PCDJ Milestones

  • The KSR (Karaoke Singer Requests) system was released for DEX 3 and LYRX customers. The free KSR utility allowed DEX 3 and LYRX customers to easily share their songbook online with karaoke singers. Singers can use their own mobile device to access the catalog, search for songs, and make requests that pop up in the rotation list within DEX 3 and/or LYRX.
  • DEX 3 received various free updates, including native support for macOS Catalina and Big Sur (and ARM M1-based Macs), a new karaoke singer scroll and custom ticker message feature, improvements to the automatic filler music player, support for additional DJ controllers , an ‘audio limiter’, and extensive performance improvements and optimizations.
  • LYRX also received at lot of development attention. All of the new karaoke features added to DEX 3 over the course of the year are mirrored in LYRX. After all, LYRX is the karaoke-specific version of DEX 3 minus the DJ features. In 2021 LYRX continued to be the most innovative and modern karaoke show hosting solution available.
  • DEX 3 RE received a slew of updates that included support for ARM M1-based Macs, new audio limiter, support for additional DJ controllers, and a myriad of performance improvements and fixes. The price of DEX 3 RE was also dropped to only $29.99 , making it the most affordable professional DJ software available.
  • Karaoki was upgraded with a “Singer Scroll” feature, displaying singers names in the queue via the ticker. A countdown timer was also added, which kicks in and displays after a singer rotates (20 seconds after playback in the player).
  • Party Tyme Karaoke continued to roll out new hit karaoke tracks each week bringing their total count to over 21,000 HD quality tunes. Due to the pandemic, Party Tyme also dropped the price of the commercially-legal karaoke subscription service from $99.99-a-month to only $49.99-a-month and the 48-hour access pass from $29.99 to $19.99.
  • Teaser: At the end of 2021 we wrapped up development of a new in-app 3rd-party service that should get DEX 3 customers pumped. Keep an eye on this website, as the announcement will come in the next couple weeks!

With 2021 in the books we’re exited to build on our momentum in 2022. New features, free updates, new services, and a more in the queue!

Happy New Year — and here’s to a happy, healthy, and prosperous 2022. We appreciate you!

The Windows 10 display settings allow you to change the appearance of your desktop and customize it to your liking. There are many different display settings you can adjust, from adjusting the brightness of your screen to choosing the size of text and icons on your monitor. Here is a step-by-step guide on how to adjust your Windows 10 display settings.

1. Find the Start button located at the bottom left corner of your screen. Click on the Start button and then select Settings.

2. In the Settings window, click on System.

3. On the left side of the window, click on Display. This will open up the display settings options.

4. You can adjust the brightness of your screen by using the slider located at the top of the page. You can also change the scaling of your screen by selecting one of the preset sizes or manually adjusting the slider.

5. To adjust the size of text and icons on your monitor, scroll down to the Scale and layout section. Here you can choose between the recommended size and manually entering a custom size. Once you have chosen the size you would like, click the Apply button to save your changes.

6. You can also adjust the orientation of your display by clicking the dropdown menu located under Orientation. You have the options to choose between landscape, portrait, and rotated.

7. Next, scroll down to the Multiple displays section. Here you can choose to extend your display or duplicate it onto another monitor.

8. Finally, scroll down to the Advanced display settings section. Here you can find more advanced display settings such as resolution and color depth.

By making these adjustments to your Windows 10 display settings, you can customize your desktop to fit your personal preference. Additionally, these settings can help improve the clarity of your monitor for a better viewing experience.
